title: てみる, the や particle, から and the exclusive "and"
summary: Try something and see with 〜てみる, list things with と (complete) versus や (and more), and mark a starting point with から.

blocks.text: Attach **みる** to a て-form and the verb means "do it to find out what happens". You are confident you can do the action; you are unsure of the result (how it tastes, what it is like). It is a gentle, curious try.

blocks.jp: この料理を食べてみる。
もう一度やってみてください。
blocks.en: Please try doing it once more.

blocks.jp: 下を見てみたけど、暗すぎて何も見えなかった。
blocks.en: I tried looking down, but it was too dark to see anything.

blocks.text: Notice the last sentence: with **見える** (can be seen) the thing that is visible is the main carriage. The zero here is **何** ("nothing"), not the speaker.
**間** means a stretch of time, "while". A clause + 間に marks the time frame. Words ending in り (ゆっくり, たっぷり) are adverbs and take no に, and relative times (その後) take no に either.

blocks.jp: 落ちる間に、ゆっくり周りを見た。

blocks.text: Both join nouns, but **と** is **exclusive**: the list is complete. **や** is **non-exhaustive**: these things, among others.

blocks.en: There are pens and pencils (and nothing else).
There are pens, pencils and so on.

blocks.text: **から** marks the point something starts from: where, or when.

blocks.en: (I) took a jar from the shelf.

items: **て-form + みる**: try doing it and see what happens.
**と**: a complete list. **や**: some examples, and others.
**から**: from a place or a time.

options: Trying something to see the result
questions.note: 食べてみる: try eating it and see.

questions.instruction: Which one lists pens and pencils and nothing else?
questions.note: と is exclusive; や implies there are more.

questions.instruction: Which one lists pens and pencils among other things?

questions.prompt: 棚＿＿瓶を取った。 (took a jar from the shelf)
questions.note: から marks the starting point.
から marks the start time.

questions.instruction: In 何も見えなかった, who or what is the zero carriage?
options: The thing that could not be seen (何)
questions.note: 見える says something is visible, so the visible thing is the main carriage.

questions.prompt: 〜てみる suggests you are sure about the result.
questions.note: You can do it, but you do not know what it will be like.

questions.instruction: Which time word takes no に?
questions.note: その後 is relative; 三時, 月曜日 and 八月 are absolute.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that marks the starting point
What does 間に add to a clause?
questions.note: 間 is a stretch of time.

questions.instruction: Pick the best sentence for "Please try this once"
options: これを一度食べてみてください
これを一度食べるみてください
これを一度食べてみるください
これを一度食べたみてください
questions.note: て-form + みて + ください.
